message:
The six functions pass material and motion from ground to bin. Traverse ground has two substantive means from Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead and Power Structure and Integration Lead, while Loosen soil, Collect soil, Contain soil, Discharge soil each have only Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead substantive and Coordinate blind operation has only Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead substantive, so for Loosen soil, Collect soil, Contain soil and Discharge soil Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead, Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead and Power Structure and Integration Lead still owe one real alternative each and for Coordinate blind operation Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead, Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead and Power Structure and Integration Lead still owe one. The two weakest are Loosen soil where chain versus scraper power is undecided and Discharge soil where pour clearance and tip with raised load is unchecked, so for those two each member shall bring one distant-analogy concept with a written mapping in cycle 2, and the critical quantity nobody computed is ladder digging mechanical power and mission energy per trip versus pack energy plus dump lip clearance height.

The stowed machine fits the start box and the mass fits the limit with everyday scales comfortable except the frame. Plain words: the folding chassis tucks to suitcase size and weighs like a person with spare margin, wheels float softer than a foot and pull far harder than cutting needs. Stowed size 0.900 m by 0.450 m by 0.450 m against 1.00 m by 0.500 m by 0.500 m from the side and top view folding chassis sketch (E24), total 47.0 kg against 60.0 kg leaving 13.0 kg margin from the mass sum against the 60 kg limit (E41), ground pressure 15.6 kPa from the ground pressure estimate (E25), traction 294 N against cut 32.9 N from the BP-1 shallow scraper cut force estimate (E9) margin 8.90 from the tip-over and stopping check (E23), where Black Point-1 (BP-1, meaning crushed basalt lunar simulant) cut is about 3 kg weight. The two stop distances reconcile as brake-only versus coast-plus-brake, and the frame sag is a hand width not millimetres. Brake-only stop 0.0625 m in 0.250 s from the tip-over and stopping check (E23) versus total 0.308 m in 0.750 s with 0.500 s link loss at 0.500 m per s from the link-loss watchdog stop distance vs latency at 0.5 m/s simulation (E32), both well under 1 g, while rail sag 72.9 mm from the cantilever deflection estimate frame rail (E43) far exceeds millimetre stiffness under 6061-T6 aluminium allowed stress from the Aluminum square tubing strength (E38), so everyday check fails.

There are no open blocking objections to resolve, and I agree with all four not-ready opinions because arching, deflection, power and fiducial tests are open. Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead is not ready for arching and wear bench tests, Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead is not ready pending mass and slip correction, Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead is not ready pending power and fiducial visibility, Power Structure and Integration Lead is not ready for deflection failure where Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU, meaning motion sensor for tilt and turn) plus odometry with 5.00 m fiducial reset bounds error to 0.100 m to 0.150 m from the blind localization drift growth odometry plus IMU without external fix simulation (E33) and heating rise 18.0 K after 300 s from the motor heating estimate (E44) is warm skin, so Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4, meaning safe long-life rechargeable chemistry) pack 24.0 V 20.0 Ah for 480 Wh remains plausible once the frame is stiffened and ladder power is budgeted.

RECORD: Decided traverse on grouser wheels with folding arms inside box and blind operation on cameras plus heartbeat stop plus fiducial reset; numbers standing are cut 32.9 N (E9), traction 294 N margin 8.90 (E23), pressure 15.6 kPa (E25), stowed 0.900 by 0.450 by 0.450 m (E24), mass 47.0 kg vs 60.0 kg (E41), stop 0.0625 m brake-only (E23) vs 0.308 m with loss (E32), drift 0.100 to 0.150 m with 5.00 m reset (E33), hopper 30.0 kg max 15 kg trips fill 112 s (E10)(E11), sag 72.9 mm fail (E43), heat 18.0 K (E44); open are second concepts for F2-F6, ladder power and energy, dump clearance and tip, frame stiffening, fiducial test; owed by named leads in cycle 2.
Note on Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead: strong ladder plus hopper evidence with clear traction margin and honest fallback.
Note on Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead: good envelope pagina with tip and stop quantified but slip correction still owed.
Note on Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead: clear blind pattern with stop and drift bounded but power and visibility test still owed.
Note on Power Structure and Integration Lead: honest mass and heat budget that exposed frame failure to fix.
Not ready, because second alternatives, ladder power, dump clearance, frame stiffness and bench tests are still open.
